title.value: Aspirations and Practice of ML Model Documentation: Moving the Needle with Nudging and Traceability
title.justification: The title clearly states the central focus of the paper on ML model documentation practices and efforts to improve them through specific methods such as nudging and traceability.
title.quote: Aspirations and Practice of ML Model Documentation: Moving the Needle with Nudging and Traceability

extractions.description: This paper investigates the current practices of documenting machine learning models through model cards and highlights the gap between proposed best practices and actual implementations. The authors designed a tool called DocML to encourage better documentation by nudging data scientists towards more comprehensive model cards. The study reveals the challenges and potential improvements in the documentation of ML models, focusing on ethical considerations, model scope, and accountability.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the documentation practices for machine learning models rather than addressing climate or ecological sustainable development themes directly.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Our analysis of publicly available model cards reveals a substantial gap between the proposal and the practice. We then design a tool named DocML aiming to (1) nudge the data scien- tists to comply with the model cards proposal during the model development, especially the sections related to ethics, and (2) assess and manage the documentation quality.

primary_category.justification: There is no direct mention or focus on climate or ecological sustainable development categories throughout the paper, as it primarily deals with the technical aspects of ML model documentation practices.
primary_category.quote: serious issues related to misuse of ML models have been observed in various applications, notably in face recognition and tracking, recruitment, and criminal risk assessment, leading to broader concerns about their impact on social justice.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address any secondary themes related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
secondary_categories.quote: Machine-learned (ML) models increasingly are integrated as components into software systems and would benefit from similar documentation.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category of the paper does not match any predefined Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development sub-categories as it focuses on ML documentation, not sustainability issues.
primary_sub_category.quote: DocML offers a preview of the model card during development time that is effectively separated from the notebook markdown cells.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Since the paper does not engage with secondary Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development sub-categories, none can be assigned.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The documentation practice for machine-learned (ML) models often falls short of established practices for traditional software.

applications.justification: The applications discussed in the paper relate to improving ML documentation, not climate or ecological sustainability.
applications.quote: Our work contributes to filling the wide gap between aspiration and practice for ML documentation.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is not related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development; hence, proposing a new category is unnecessary.
new_primary_category.quote: Machine-learned (ML) models increasingly are integrated as components into software systems and would benefit from similar documentation.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not suggest any novel sub-categories related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: As discussed, our rubric does not assess the completeness or correctness of information, but only whether a model card includes information related to the sections in the model cards proposal.
